companyDescription: SpaceX · Starlink broadband (10M+ subscribers, 61% of revenue) + Falcon 9/Heavy launch + Starship V3 development · Largest US IPO on record (Jun 12, 2026, $85.7B raised)
priceNote: Live $143.09 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Jul 14) used $137.41 (+4.1%) but was 120 days old. Q3 was reported Oct 22 (+7.8%). Starship Flight 15 is expected in November (no confirmed date).
summary: Refresh (120 days stale): Q3 was reported Oct 22 with revenue +161% y/y and adj. EBITDA +306%, and the stock rose 7.8%. Flight 14 reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites but ended early. The next events: (1) Starship Flight 15, expected in November with a booster-and-ship catch attempt but no confirmed date, so it is not used as a dated catalyst; (2) the post-IPO lockup, with the bulk of remaining shares tradable by Dec 9, a dated supply event (Musk's stake stays locked to Jun 2027). Management targets weekly Starship cadence in 1H27. At a ~$2T cap, +20% needs a cadence breakthrough, and the Dec 9 unlock is a headwind. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

catalysts.name: Post-IPO lockup expiry — bulk of shares tradable
catalysts.description: The bulk of the remaining locked shares become tradable by Dec 9, 2026 (supply headwind). Musk's stake stays locked until Jun 2027.

catalysts.name: Starship Flight 15 — booster + ship catch attempt
catalysts.description: Expected November per the Q3 call; no confirmed date.

risks: Starship has a real, recent failure history — Flight 12 (May 22) failed its flip-and-boostback maneuver, and Flight 13 needs to demonstrate a fix, not just attempt the same maneuver again. Another failure would extend the post-IPO drawdown.

Extreme analyst target dispersion ($190 to $800) reflects genuine, unresolved disagreement about valuation methodology this early in the company's public life — treat any single number, including this report's gate figures, as a rough estimate, not a settled consensus
Down 30% since debut already — the stock has shown it can move sharply on sentiment around Starship specifically, independent of the actually-profitable Starlink business

At a ~$2.1-2.3T valuation, SPCX is priced for enormous execution success across both Starlink scaling and Starship commercialization — a lot of the bull case is already reflected in the price even after the pullback
Newly public (5 weeks old as of this report) — limited trading history means technical support/resistance levels and typical volatility patterns are not yet well-established

analystTargets.note: Extreme outlier — supporting color only, not the gate basis
Reiterated ahead of the Flight 13 launch

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM-HIGH. As a newly-public mega-cap trading on execution narrative more than established fundamentals-multiple discipline, SPCX is more exposed than a seasoned mega-cap to a broad risk-off shock, especially with Flight 13 landing just before the dense Jul 27-Aug 1 macro week.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.

entryStrategy.verdict: HOLD — the only dated event is a Dec 9 lockup expiry (a headwind). Flight 15 is undated. Not a near-term upside catalyst at ~$2T. Measured core at-catalyst median is -6.9% (n=54), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: As a newly-public stock with no long trading history, SPCX doesn't yet have an established pre-event drift pattern — the stock has instead been in a steady post-IPO decline heading into Flight 13, suggesting the market is pricing in real failure risk rather than assuming success.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: no established pattern yet — 5 weeks of trading history
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: declining into the event so far (-30% since debut), not a typical positive pre-run

postWin.note: No same-company precedent exists for a post-IPO Starship test result yet. Sized using the standard pattern for a major aerospace test-flight success reversing recent sentiment-driven weakness — a clean Flight 13 would directly address the exact concern (flip-and-boostback failure) that has weighed on the stock.
postWin.exampleDate: no same-company precedent yet — first major test post-IPO

postLose.note: Flight 12's flip-and-boostback failure (May 22, pre-IPO) is the closest same-company precedent for a Starship test setback, though the stock wasn't yet public then. Sized using typical aerospace-test-failure reactions plus the added sensitivity of a newly-public, sentiment-driven stock.

spotSizing.reason: Speculative sizing — Starlink provides real fundamental support, but the stock is newly public, already down 30% since debut, and facing a genuinely binary near-term test flight. 4% balances real upside exposure against the demonstrated volatility.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Below Entry 2 zone before Jul 16 = market pricing in a Flight 13 failure

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Flight 13 fails the flip-and-boostback maneuver again, exit — don't average into a repeated technical failure

comparableCases.note: Same-company precedent (pre-IPO) for how the market/company narrative reacted to the exact failure mode Flight 13 needs to fix — directly relevant to the binary outcome ahead.
Same-company precedent for the stock's demonstrated sensitivity to Starship sentiment even without a specific failure event — shows how much of the current price already reflects caution.
Comparable space-sector reaction to a strong positive surprise — useful proxy for the magnitude a clean Flight 13 success could produce, given no exact same-event precedent exists for SPCX yet.

th.summary: รีเฟรช (เก่า 120 วัน): งบ Q3 ออก 22 ต.ค. รายได้ +161% y/y และ adj. EBITDA +306% หุ้นขึ้น 7.8% เที่ยวบิน 14 ขึ้นถึงวงโคจรและปล่อยดาวเทียม Starlink V3 26 ดวง แต่จบก่อนกำหนด event ถัดไป: (1) Starship เที่ยวบิน 15 คาดใน พ.ย. พร้อมพยายามจับทั้ง booster และยาน แต่ไม่มีวันยืนยัน จึงไม่นับเป็น catalyst ที่มีวัน (2) หุ้นหลัง IPO ส่วนใหญ่ปลด lockup ภายใน 9 ธ.ค. เป็นแรงขายที่มีวันแน่นอน (หุ้นของ Musk ยังล็อกถึง มิ.ย. 2027) ผู้บริหารตั้งเป้าปล่อย Starship ทุกสัปดาห์ในครึ่งแรกปี 2027 ที่ cap ~$2T การขึ้น +20% ต้องอาศัยความก้าวหน้าด้านความถี่การปล่อย และการปลดล็อก 9 ธ.ค. เป็นแรงต้าน bias ของ Base ใน core +23.7pp เทียบ P75 14 วันจริง +6.6% Base จึงเป็นกรอบหลายสัปดาห์ ไม่ใช่คาด 14 วัน
